title: Economy Various Initiative By Different Kings
definition: The economic framework of the Delhi Sultanate (1206–1526) was characterized by a centralized agrarian taxation system, state-controlled market regulations, and the monetization of the economy through the Iqta system.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the evolution of land revenue systems (Kharaj, Ushr), market reforms (Alauddin Khalji), and currency innovations (Muhammad bin Tughlaq) as they reflect the transition from feudal to centralized state control.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Economy Various Initiative By Different Kings.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Medieval Indian Feudalism
Concept of Iqta and Khalisa lands
